This code downloads weather variables from ClimateNA, Daymet, GridMet and TCC from Landfire (the latter two not used in analysis). All other data was downloaded manually.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(keyring)
library(appeears) #Download daymet from Nasa Earthdata
library(sf) #Use to request daymet data for a polygon
library(ClimateNAr) #Download ClimateNA Data
```

# ClimateNA

```{r climateNA}
# Load Colorado Shapefile to use to Crop elevation raster for input
fires_cna <- st_read("C:/Users/Elizabeth Buhr/OneDrive/Documents/fuels-analysis/data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "fires") %>% 
  st_transform("EPSG:5070")

#Load DEM Raster and Crop to state
dem <- rast("D:/Spatial_Data/LANDFIRE/LF2020_Elev_CONUS/Tif/LF2020_Elev_CONUS.tif") %>%
  crop(fires_cna) %>%
  mask(fires_cna) %>%
  project("EPSG:4326") #Project to WGS84 for use with ClimateNA

#Save DEM so we can just upload it as a path
writeRaster(dem, "D:/Spatial_Data/ClimateNA/dem_wgs84.tif", overwrite = TRUE, NAflag = -9999)

# Normals
ClimateNAr(inputFile = 'D:/Spatial_Data/ClimateNA/dem_wgs84.tif', periodList = c('Normal_1981_2010.nrm'), varList = c('MAT', 'MAP', 'CMD', 'Eref', 'Tave_sm'), outDir = 'D:/Spatial_Data/ClimateNA/')

# Annual
ClimateNAr(inputFile = 'D:/Spatial_Data/ClimateNA/dem_wgs84.tif', periodList = 2010:2024, varList = c('MAT', 'MAP', 'CMD', 'Eref'), outDir = 'D:/Spatial_Data/ClimateNA/')
```

# Weather

(maximum temperature, wind velocity, relative humidity, VPD) 
(Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI), Energy Release Component, 100- and 1000-hour dead fuel moisture)
FWI? 

```{r}
## Maximum temperature
dir.create(here("data", "raw", "GridMet", "TMax"), showWarnings = FALSE) 
for(j in 2010:2024){ 
  if(!file.exists(here("data", "raw", "GridMet", "TMax", paste0("tmmx_", j, ".nc")))){ 
  temp <- here("data", "raw", "GridMet", "TMax", paste0("tmmx_", j, ".nc")) 
  download.file(paste0("https://www.northwestknowledge.net/metdata/data/tmmx_", j, ".nc"), temp, mode="wb") 
  }
}
```

# Pre-Fire Fuels

```{r}
# Canopy Cover
if(!dir.exists( here("data", "raw", "LANDFIRE", "US_105_CC"))){
  temp <- here("data", "raw", "LANDFIRE", "US_105_CC.zip")
  download.file("https://landfire.gov/data-downloads/US_105/US_105_CC.zip", temp, mode="wb")
  unzip(temp, exdir=here("data", "raw", "LANDFIRE"))
  file.remove(temp)
}
```
